title: Smoked Comte Salad
description: A smoky twist on a classic salad featuring Comte cheese and fresh ingredients.

ingredients.name: Comte cheese
ingredients.notes: Aged Comte cheese for its rich flavor

ingredients.name: Mixed greens
ingredients.notes: Fresh and crisp for the base of the salad

ingredients.name: Lush lettuce
ingredients.notes: A crunchy addition to the salad

ingredients.name: Salad
ingredients.notes: Fresh veggies for extra crunch and flavor

instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine mixed greens, smoked uruguayan chorizo, and salad.
2. Cut the Comte cheese into small cubes and add to the bowl.
3. In a small bowl, whisk together your favorite vinaigrette ingredients.
4. Drizzle the vinaigrette over the salad and toss to combine.
5. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
6. Serve immediately, garnished with additional Comte cheese if desired.
